{{Top|leg}}
A '''droid linkup''' was an optional feature on the [[MicroThrust Processors]]' [[Clockwatcher]]. When combined with a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], it allowed constant communication with a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The responses could either be relayed audibly, or on the [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer's]] screen.
